faq.q: What is the best boat for a Pride 2036 celebration in Marbella?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is ideal for larger groups, with a free jet ski included from €4,719 for 4 hours. For smaller parties, the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) at €749 for 2 hours offers a more intimate setting. Both depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Can we bring our own decorations for Pride 2036?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring rainbow flags, balloons, and other decorations. We recommend coordinating with our team to ensure safety and setup. Some boats have spacious decks perfect for a Pride-themed party.

faq.q: What is included in the yacht charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Tier B boats also include a free jet ski.

faq.q: How many guests can join a yacht for Pride 2036?
faq.a: Our fleet accommodates 5 to 12 guests. The Ferretti 94 (29m) and Canados 86 (26m) both hold up to 12 guests. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (8m) take up to 5 guests. Check individual boat specs for exact capacity.

faq.q: What are the departure points for Pride 2036 charters?
faq.a: All our yachts depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic superyacht marina. From there, you can cruise to Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or along the Golden Mile. Custom itineraries to Estepona or Sotogrande are available.

faq.q: Can we book a DJ or music system for the party?
faq.a: Yes, we can arrange a Bluetooth speaker or a professional DJ setup on most boats. The Mangusta 80 and Azimut 58 Flybridge have excellent sound systems. Contact us via WhatsApp for custom requests.

faq.q: How far in advance should we book for Pride 2036?
faq.a: Pride 2036 is expected to be popular, so we recommend booking at least 2-3 weeks in advance. Peak dates may fill up quickly. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability and secure your preferred boat.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for Pride 2036 charters?
faq.a: Cancellations made 14 days or more before the charter date receive a full refund. Between 7-13 days, a 50% refund applies. Less than 7 days, no refund. Weather-related cancellations are handled case by case.

data.body_html:
Celebrate Pride 2036 on the Costa del Sol with a Marbella yacht charter that combines luxury, freedom, and inclusivity. Whether you're planning a vibrant sea party or a relaxed sunset cruise, our fleet of 16 boats from Puerto Banús offers the perfect setting for up to 12 guests. With inclusive drinks, snacks, and a licensed skipper, you can focus on celebrating love and diversity against the backdrop of Marbella's stunning coastline.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for Pride 2036 in Marbella?

Marbella is synonymous with glamour, and Pride 2036 is your chance to experience it from the water. A private yacht gives you the freedom to design your own celebration—anchoring at Cala del Faro, cruising past the Golden Mile, or partying under the stars. Unlike crowded beach clubs, a yacht offers intimacy, privacy, and a unique perspective of the coast. Plus, all our charters include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks, so you can relax and enjoy.

Our Fleet for Pride 2036 Celebrations

From the compact Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) to the majestic Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), we have a boat for every group size and budget. Here are our top picks for Pride 2036:

  • Tier A boats – Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax): from €749 for 2 hours, perfect for intimate celebrations.
  • Tier B boats – Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) in white or grey: from €4,719 for 4 hours, includes a free jet ski for extra fun.
  • Other luxury yachts – Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, and Maiora 26m: pricing on request via WhatsApp, ideal for larger parties.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. Check our full fleet list for details.

Pricing and Inclusions for Pride 2036

Our all-inclusive pricing means no hidden costs. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). For Tier B boats, a jet ski is included free. See our pricing tiers:

Customising Your Pride 2036 Experience

Make your celebration unforgettable with optional extras: rainbow decorations, a DJ setup, or a bespoke catering menu. Our team can arrange a Bluetooth speaker or professional sound system on most boats. For food, we can organise a tapas platter or a full buffet. Cruise to Cabopino for a beach stop, or head to Estepona for a longer voyage. The coastline from Marbella to Sotogrande offers endless possibilities.

Best Routes for a Pride Celebration at Sea

From Puerto Banús, you have several scenic routes. A popular option is cruising east to Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, where you can anchor for a swim. Alternatively, head west towards Estepona for a longer trip. For a sunset party, stay close to the Golden Mile and watch the sun dip behind La Concha mountain. If you're feeling adventurous, a full-day charter to Sotogrande offers a change of scenery and a chance to see the Costa del Sol's exclusive side.

How to Book Your Pride 2036 Yacht Charter

Booking is simple. Browse our fleet, choose your preferred boat, and contact us via WhatsApp with your date and group size. We'll confirm availability and send a quote. For Tier A and Tier B boats, you can book directly online. For other yachts, we'll provide a personalised quote. We recommend booking at least 2-3 weeks in advance, as Pride 2036 is expected to be a busy period.

Ready to celebrate? Explore our full fleet and start planning your Pride 2036 sea party today.
